CHAP.audited_behavior: GradSim_3d flattens the last encoder Conv3d output-channel kernels, obtains supervised/unsupervised gradients via backward and optimizer.zero_grad, keeps moving averages, and multiplies signed cosine by relative unsupervised gradient norm. This diagnostic reuses the parameter-coordinate concept only, separates cosine from magnitude, discovers modules by type, and uses autograd.grad without moving averages or optimizer state.

DuCiSC.audited_behavior: Four ordered deep-supervision heads. Current local baseline retains nearest-resampled GT CE/Dice and aggregate per-objective LossNorm, but uses four-scale softmax MSE consistency rather than upstream full DuCiSC hard-pseudo-label/prototype/mix objectives. No upstream training code is executed.
